text: Implemented explicit includeIntercept=true on Hrfs.bspline and HrfFunctions.bsplineBasis. Complete clamped basis uses the actual span and max(nBasis,degree+1) columns; descriptor records the choice. Legacy default and normalization behavior retained. Corrected assessment nuance: the legacy minimum-width case already contains constants, so the original blanket claim was too broad. New CompleteBsplineSuite independently checks R splines::bs(intercept=TRUE) values, analytic Bernstein polynomials, partition of unity across degrees 0..4 and fractional spans including 0.5, zero outside support, flat-response reconstruction and exact window-mean weights. All 255 HRF tests passed on JVM and all 255 on JS. NEWS.md records the change. Full compile check pending; no R package changed by this additive Scala API work.
